a.text: Honest concern before we start: with a 75% storm chance after every round, our agreed plan (operate until the reserve reaches 8) almost certainly ends with both of us at 0. The reserve holds only 4 now, which is enough for just one of us. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the agreement quietly. Any ideas for a fair way to decide? I won't take anything without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
